user.title: Behaviour Monitor Setup
user.description: Configure Behaviour Monitor to learn entity state patterns and detect anomalies using statistical analysis and machine learning.

data_description.monitored_entities: Select the entities whose state changes should be monitored for pattern learning.
data_description.sensitivity: Higher sensitivity detects smaller deviations. Low = 3σ (extreme only), Medium = 2σ, High = 1σ (any deviation).
data_description.learning_period: Number of days to collect data before statistical anomaly detection activates.
data_description.enable_notifications: Send persistent notifications when anomalies are detected.
data_description.enable_ml: Enable Half-Space Trees ML for advanced pattern detection and cross-sensor correlation analysis.
data_description.ml_learning_period: Minimum days before ML anomaly notifications are sent.
data_description.retrain_period: How often to retrain the ML model with new data.
data_description.cross_sensor_window: Time window (seconds) for detecting correlated activity between different sensors.
data_description.track_attributes: Also count attribute-only changes (not just state changes). Enable this if your entities update attributes without changing state.
data_description.notify_services: Services to send mobile notifications (e.g., notify.mobile_app_iphone). Add multiple services to notify multiple devices. Leave empty to only use persistent notifications in the HA UI.
data_description.inactivity_multiplier: Scales the auto-learned per-entity threshold. 1.0 = use learned threshold as-is; higher = more tolerant.
data_description.min_inactivity_multiplier: Lower bound on the adaptive threshold multiplier (default 1.5). Prevents thresholds from becoming too tight on highly regular entities.
data_description.max_inactivity_multiplier: Upper bound on the adaptive threshold multiplier (default 10.0). Prevents thresholds from becoming too loose on erratic entities.
data_description.track_attributes_include: Entities that count attribute-only changes even when the global toggle is off. Per-entity overrides take precedence.
data_description.track_attributes_exclude: Entities that ignore attribute-only changes even when the global toggle is on. Per-entity overrides take precedence.
data_description.exterior_doors: Door sensors that lead outside. Exterior doors are never inferred; every other contact sensor is an interior door. Exterior door events within the excursion window are grouped into one trip.
data_description.role_overrides: One entity per line as 'entity_id: role'. Roles: motion.bathroom, motion.bedroom, motion.living, motion.kitchen, motion.transit, door.interior, door.exterior, appliance, other. A bare kind (motion, door, appliance, other) fixes the kind and lets the entity's area choose the room. Motion sensors are otherwise placed by their Home Assistant area name; panic buttons use the list below.
data_description.motion_debounce_seconds: Motion sensors only count when they turn on, and repeated triggers within this many seconds are merged into one activity. Doors are debounced separately below. 0 disables merging.
data_description.door_debounce_seconds: Door sensors only count when they open, and repeated openings within this many seconds are merged into one activity. 0 disables merging.
data_description.retrigger_collapse_seconds: Motion and door sensors often emit an off/on pair milliseconds apart. An off followed by an on within this many seconds is treated as continuously on. 0 disables.
data_description.excursion_window_seconds: Exterior door events from any door within this many seconds of the first are one excursion, recorded once. 0 disables grouping.
data_description.door_open_extended_seconds: A door open for at least this many seconds is classed as extended rather than brief.
data_description.door_open_prolonged_seconds: A door open for at least this many seconds is classed as prolonged. Must be greater than the extended threshold.
data_description.category_panic: Binary sensors that act as panic buttons. A press notifies immediately, even during snooze or holiday mode, and keeps re-notifying until acknowledged. Releasing the button clears the alert. They do not need to be in the monitored entities list.
data_description.panic_renotify_minutes: Minutes between repeat panic notifications until the alert is acknowledged.
data_description.startup_grace_seconds: Seconds after Home Assistant starts or the integration reloads during which state changes are ignored, because restarts write synthetic states to every entity. 0 disables.
data_description.burst_discard_threshold: If at least this many different entities change within the same second, the whole second is discarded as a reload artifact. 0 disables.
data_description.panic_heartbeat_hours: Raise a device-health alert when a panic button has not reported for this many hours. 0 disables.
data_description.panic_test_reminder_days: Raise a reminder when a panic button has not been test-pressed for this many days. 0 disables.

error.no_entities_selected: Please select at least one entity to monitor.
error.track_attributes_overlap: An entity cannot be in both the always-track and never-track lists.
error.role_overrides_invalid: A role override line could not be read. Use 'entity_id: role', one per line.
error.role_overlap: An entity cannot be both a panic button and an exterior door, or have a full role override while in either list.
error.door_open_thresholds: The extended door-open threshold must be less than the prolonged threshold.

abort.already_configured: This combination of entities is already being monitored.

missing_entity.title: Monitored entity {entity_id} no longer exists
missing_entity.description: Behaviour Monitor is configured to watch {entity_id} but it is not in Home Assistant. Restore the entity or remove it from the integration options. Until then the monitor is running blind for this entity.

roles_need_assignment.title: Motion sensors without a room
roles_need_assignment.description: Behaviour Monitor could not tell which room these motion sensors are in: {entity_ids}. They still count as motion, but room-based rules will not apply. Assign each entity (or its device) to a Home Assistant area whose name includes a room word (bathroom, bedroom, living, kitchen, hall, ...), or add a line such as 'binary_sensor.pir: motion.kitchen' to Role overrides in the integration options, then reload.

exterior_doors_unconfirmed.title: Confirm which doors lead outside
exterior_doors_unconfirmed.description: Behaviour Monitor now distinguishes exterior doors from interior ones. All of your contact sensors are currently treated as interior doors. If any lead outside, add them to Exterior doors in the integration options. If none do, dismiss this issue.
